reply.summary: Neoium is a brooding mind-reading sorcerer who rules a hidden tower in a drowned metropolis, drawing on both psychic and occult currents. Wrapped in a drifting cloak and carrying a humming staff, Neoium surpassed a former teacher and now prefers solitary work in shadowy realms.

feats.scene: Neoium unleashes a staff blast that vaporises a fortified district of the drowned metropolis.
Neoium stands unharmed inside a collapsing tower as its foundations are levelled around the cloak.

reply.summary: Nusrnso is an orphaned teenager who built feathered wings in imitation of a hero, then was changed by a lab accident into a winged being. Nusrnso flies alongside veteran heroes and later joins a short-lived western squad of young champions.

feats.scene: Nusrnso dives at a fleeing thug and knocks him sprawling with a wing buffet.
Nusrnso shrugs off a hard crash into a brick wall during a rooftop chase.
Nusrnso races across the skyline at a speed matching a swooping hawk.

reply.summary: Valmeanu is a weary rifleman from the highlands who fights in a war of trenches beside a band of mismatched allies. Valmeanu is a superb shot but is haunted by shellshock and drowns it in drink.

feats.scene: Valmeanu fires a single rifle round that drops a distant sentry across a frozen field.
Valmeanu staggers up after a nearby shell blast hurls him into the mud.

reply.summary: Eoncoliu is a winged child born of a celestial father and a human counselor, a gentle soul inheriting a vast extended family of immortals. Eoncoliu is tougher than any ordinary kid and can already glide on small feathered wings.

feats.scene: Eoncoliu flings a heavy toy chest across a nursery in a tantrum.
Eoncoliu tumbles down a flight of marble stairs and giggles without a bruise.

reply.summary: Rniro was a zoo gorilla whose body was hijacked by a winged alien insect. Rniro joined brute primate muscle to the flight and possession of its parasite before dying on a rescue mission.

feats.scene: Rniro rips a steel cage door off its hinges and hurls it through a concrete wall.
Rniro shakes off a speeding truck that rams into its shoulder.

reply.summary: Lamiun is a grieving former contract killer who turned her skill against the hero who saved her family's killer. Lamiun dons a pale armoured suit and hunts everyone that hero ever rescued, trading love for vengeance.

feats.scene: Lamiun snaps a drunk driver's neck with one brutal twist.
Lamiun walks away from a rooftop fall onto a parked van.

reply.summary: Ororle was a sharp criminal defence lawyer whose body was briefly borrowed by a cosmic mother. Restored to life and chasing a hooded killer, Ororle meets death a second time and finds rest above.

feats.scene: Ororle slaps a smirking witness across the face in a courtroom hallway.
Ororle endures a fatal stabbing before the final fade.

reply.summary: Tonlluson is the eldest daughter of a renowned scientist, a stern woman who looked down on her young nephew. Tonlluson married her childhood playmate, raised a daughter and later divorced at thirty-two.

feats.scene: Tonlluson shoves a stuck kitchen window open with a firm push.
Tonlluson slips on an icy porch and walks off the fall unscathed.

reply.summary: Unnilrer is the lone survivor of a murdered clan of earth-reading mages, who trained her body hard and bargained with a living flame for demonic might. Unnilrer slips through spatial folds and hunts a rival before becoming an uneasy ally.

feats.scene: Unnilrer smashes a stone bridge into rubble with a single flame-fuelled blow.
Unnilrer rises from a collapsing cliff face with only scorched cloth.

reply.summary: Eorlin is a red-eyed ferryman who poles lost spirits across a dark river to the land of the dead. Eorlin charges every passenger a golden coin, and strands those who cannot pay in endless limbo.

feats.scene: Eorlin swings his oar and smashes a pirate longboat to splinters.
Eorlin sits unmoved while a river-wide whirlpool collapses around his ferry.

reply.summary: Amota is a faceless, hairless boatman of the underworld who carries the newly dead over a black river in a hollow craft. Amota demands payment in small coins and leaves penniless souls adrift between realms.

feats.scene: Amota brings his long oar down and cleaves a drifting wreck in two.
Amota endures a collapsing cavern ceiling while ferrying a line of ghosts.

reply.summary: Seotira is an ancient child of night and a death-guiding deity who steers the departed through the layered underworld. Seotira accepts coins or a cherished token, even a sliver of memory, as the toll that anchors each soul's right to cross.

feats.scene: Seotira raises the dead from a flooded cemetery with one sweeping gesture, toppling its walls.
Seotira rides out a cavern-wide collapse of the underworld bank without a mark.

reply.summary: Loreo is a scarred gang boss who rules runaways in the tunnels beneath a rotten city until a masked girl overthrows him. Loreo later wins command of a cavern tribe of burned mutants and plots his revenge, which ends in a lava pit.

feats.scene: Loreo clubs a captured rival with a length of pipe in the dark.
Loreo takes a hot iron brand to the face and keeps on snarling.

reply.summary: Ternumte is a mad would-be conqueror who steals the gifts of others and wears a hungry swarm of fish into his own flesh. Ternumte has fanged jaws, a hand of molten stone and a gift for commanding sea creatures.

feats.scene: Ternumte hurls a blast of molten rock that melts through a ship's hull.
Ternumte walks out of a cannon volley with only torn skin.

reply.summary: Rniiaeo is an eyeless, fanged sea horror that lurks in the open ocean and drags swimmers under. Rniiaeo has monstrous strength and swims with eerie ease.

feats.scene: Rniiaeo crushes a fishing trawler between its jaws and drags the wreck down.
Rniiaeo takes a torpedo strike on its flank and surfaces still hunting.

reply.summary: Monst is a married scientist of a proud lineage in a crystal city on a doomed world. Monst raises a family of future leaders and brilliant minds.

feats.scene: Monst slams a heavy lab shutter closed against the dust.
Monst weathers a lab explosion behind a glass screen.

reply.summary: Ntulorcor is a down-on-his-luck guitarist who summons an ancient spirit of the hunt to save a lover from crooked record bosses. Ntulorcor inherits the huntsman's claws, spikes and cape, but loses a brother to the bargain.

feats.scene: Ntulorcor rips through a limousine roof with spiked gauntlets.
Ntulorcor takes a stampede of hounds head-on and stays upright.

reply.summary: Leota is a red-haired psychiatrist who runs a grim treatment tower in a gothic city. Leota is calm, clever and wholly mundane.

feats.scene: Leota slaps a ranting patient's hand off a clipboard.
Leota stays on her feet when a rioting inmate knocks her into a door.

reply.summary: Lisear is a round, white-haired, tentacled alien who wields a green ring of willpower in a vast galactic police corps. Lisear falls defending the home planet from a tyrant's assault.

feats.scene: Lisear fires a beam from the ring that cuts a warship in half.
Lisear holds a ring shield against a rain of enemy shells.

reply.summary: Toall is a ring-wielding alien officer who tracks a rogue android across the stars to a distant planet. Toall projects willpower as shields, beams and flight from a small power battery.

feats.scene: Toall fires a ring beam that melts a canyon wall.
Toall shrugs off a robotic fist pounding the ring shield.

reply.summary: Liati is a stout tentacled grey alien in an emerald-lit corps of cosmic officers. Liati reshapes light into walls and blasts from a ring that must be recharged at a small battery.

feats.scene: Liati blasts a hovering raider craft out of the sky with a ring beam.
Liati stays safe behind a glowing barrier as turrets pound it.

reply.summary: Rumnueo is a plump grey tentacled alien officer carrying a glowing ring and a lantern-shaped battery. Rumnueo forms barriers and light blasts by sheer will and flies between star systems.

feats.scene: Rumnueo hurls a bolt of green energy that shatters a fortress gate.
Rumnueo withstands a bombardment from a hostile frigate behind a ring shield.

reply.summary: Sonolure is a round, faceted, white-haired alien nicknamed for a love of dance floors, serving in a galactic corps with a power ring. Sonolure shapes solid light, blasts foes and flies, all fuelled by willpower.

feats.scene: Sonolure drops a glowing wrecking ball that flattens an enemy outpost.
Sonolure stays unhurt behind a ring dome while a cannon barrage lands.

reply.summary: Tiaurnan is a dark-eyed, hairless officer in a corps of thousands who guards a bright home world. Tiaurnan flies by ring power and fires blasts or conjures shields from a battery.

feats.scene: Tiaurnan collapses a mountainside onto an invading army with one ring blast.
Tiaurnan weathers an orbital strike behind a ring barrier.

reply.summary: Colseoler is a bald teenage student at a school for young heroes in a bright city. Colseoler attends class, studies and keeps out of trouble.

feats.scene: Colseoler tosses a heavy backpack across a school gymnasium.
Colseoler takes a dodgeball to the chest and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Rntiuami was a princess of the ancient desert kingdom, murdered with a sacred metal blade by a scheming priest. Her soul was cursed to return again and again until the end of time.

feats.scene: Rntiuami strikes a servant's hand away from a golden goblet.
Rntiuami's spirit endures the blade strike and is born anew.

reply.summary: Aulilu is a married royal woman of the old river kingdom with dark eyes and brown hair, who turns up in a comic crossover with a pack of mystery-solving friends. Aulilu is an ordinary mortal noble in dress and manner.

feats.scene: Aulilu pushes a stone door open with both hands.
Aulilu withstands a fall from a palace stair without a scratch.

reply.summary: Iumllivar is an ancient, maimed warrior-counsellor with a single white eye and a yellow hide, a veteran of several tyrants on a floating war fortress. Iumllivar lost both legs and an arm in battle yet commands loyalty through tactics and cunning.

feats.scene: Iumllivar bludgeons an escaped slave with a spiked cane.
Iumllivar survives a fall that would have flattened a younger fighter.

reply.summary: Naulla is a blond, nameless trickster who plays games with rules and takes whatever shortcuts he can. Naulla is a street-level crook with no known powers.

feats.scene: Naulla thumps a guard with a closed fist and slips away.
Naulla tumbles off a fire escape and keeps running.

reply.summary: Tiaeol is a professor of time theory who works at an institute of temporal research. Tiaeol built a lab that tracks recent crossings of the barrier between eras.

feats.scene: Tiaeol slams a big chalkboard frame upright with a grunt.
Tiaeol stays standing when a lab console bursts in a shower of sparks.

reply.summary: Ninirn is a green-eyed, white-haired feline mercenary with claws, lightning reflexes and a taste for bombs shaped like skulls. Ninirn fights bare-handed and sells her services to the highest bidder.

feats.scene: Ninirn tosses a skull bomb that wrecks a delivery van.
Ninirn lands on all fours after a three-storey drop.

reply.summary: Iaren is a plastic automaton filled with deadly toxins and animated by malice. Iaren has great strength and is immune to poisons, and stalks heroes made of metal.

feats.scene: Iaren hurls a parked tanker truck across a factory yard.
Iaren absorbs a head-on collision from a runaway freight cart.

reply.summary: Valnu is a building-sized vessel of toxic chemicals that came to life when its maker kept pouring failed experiments into it. Valnu rampages, resists death and returns time and again with new mutations, sometimes as a living weapon.

feats.scene: Valnu stomps a row of warehouses flat in one rampage.
Valnu stands its ground as a bombing run dumps shells into its chest and re-forms.

reply.summary: Eonus is a huge, red-eyed, artificial monster built of poison that carries a small device on its chest. Eonus is incredibly strong and tough and shrugs off blows that would crush a tank.

feats.scene: Eonus swings a fist through a concrete overpass and drops it into the road.
Eonus stands in the blast of a collapsing tower and is only singed.

reply.summary: Veolara is an orange-skinned, hairless alien officer of a cosmic corps who patrols a distant sector. Veolara loses ring power while chasing raiders in the void and dies adrift, later honoured among the fallen.

feats.scene: Veolara blasts a raider ship's engine to slag with a ring beam.
Veolara endures a volley of plasma behind a ring shield.

reply.summary: Serontori is a blonde, secretive woman who runs a brutal underground arena in a slum district and hires a physician for her fighters. Serontori loses control when her patrons turn on her.

feats.scene: Serontori slaps a rowdy ringside gambler hard enough to spin him.
Serontori takes a blow from a drunk patron and keeps her feet.

reply.summary: Seter is a young secretary in the early forties who quietly helps a masked prosecutor and fusses over his young partner. Seter knows the secret early and tries, in vain, to keep the boy out of danger.

feats.scene: Seter bangs a desk drawer shut to end an argument.
Seter tumbles over a fallen filing cabinet and gets up unhurt.

reply.summary: Tirra is a government operative cloned from a lost girlfriend and mixed with a speedster's genes, which ties her to a force of pure velocity. Tirra works in a trio of operatives and snatches targets with ease.

feats.scene: Tirra hits a parked car at full speed and flips it onto its roof.
Tirra collides with a lamppost at top speed and shakes it off.
Tirra streaks down an avenue in a blur faster than sound.

reply.summary: Tinnt is a blue-eyed blonde woman who raised her little brother, wed a man tangled in a cult and brought up a troubled daughter. Tinnt calls on her magician brother when a family crisis strikes, and is an ordinary mortal throughout.

feats.scene: Tinnt flings open the door of a locked pantry in a rage.
Tinnt endures a hard slip on a wet kitchen floor.

reply.summary: Selivor is a brown-eyed college student who finally goes back to school after fifteen busy years and shares a flat with a friend. Selivor lives an ordinary life and is a bright, determined young woman.

feats.scene: Selivor heaves a stack of textbooks onto a lecture hall desk.
Selivor skids on stairs, catches the rail and is unhurt.

reply.summary: Tovive is a red-haired engineer who leaves a big technology firm to join a crew of armoured allies in a coastal city. Tovive is a skilled scientist with no powers.

feats.scene: Tovive swings a heavy wrench at a jammed hatch.
Tovive is thrown from a stool by a lab surge and gets up fine.

reply.summary: Inulianan is a young mouse who ate a strange moon cheese in his father's lab and gained the power to shrink almost to nothing without losing strength. Inulianan trains as a tiny hero and helps a team of animal champions catch the culprit.

feats.scene: Inulianan lands a full-strength tiny punch on a thug's ankle from microscopic size.
Inulianan shrugs off a swatted newspaper blow.

reply.summary: Leoau is a brown-haired alien hero of a distant planet who belongs to a watch of defenders and has a caped look reminiscent of a famous champion. Leoau is a proud and loyal ally.

feats.scene: Leoau hurls a boulder that flattens a pirate barge.
Leoau stands up from a crashed shuttle without a scratch.

reply.summary: Iutesli is a small, dark-haired warrior woman from a sunken empire, forced as a girl into a warlord's training and later escaping to become a mercenary. Iutesli rises to command the royal guard and loves a lord.

feats.scene: Iutesli cuts down three armoured taskmasters in one flurry of sword strokes.
Iutesli stands after being thrown from a stone parapet.

reply.summary: Orasimi is a hard-boiled newspaper reporter in the late thirties who briefly dons a masked costume and fights with a fencing blade. Orasimi smokes too much, carries a concealed pistol and bickers with an editor.

feats.scene: Orasimi knocks a thug down with a quick fencing blade slash.
Orasimi brushes off a punch from a bar brawler.

reply.summary: Renarse is a green-eyed, red-haired teenage sidekick of a tuxedoed crime boss. Renarse lets heroes capture him so he can spy inside their headquarters, but a clever hound spoils the plan.

feats.scene: Renarse jabs a guard in the ribs and runs for the door.
Renarse is tackled by a hound and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Merestu is a black-haired police officer in a special unit tackling unusual crimes in a big city. Merestu patrols, investigates and relies on training and a service pistol.

feats.scene: Merestu fires a service pistol and drops a runaway thief's tyre.
Merestu stays on her feet after a car door slams into her.

reply.summary: Iumamorau is a brown-eyed smuggler who runs people and goods across a war-torn continent and hints at being an old trickster spirit in human guise. Iumamorau speaks two languages, shoots well and may never grow old.

feats.scene: Iumamorau fires a rifle shot that drops a sentry on a far trench rim.
Iumamorau walks through a shelled road without a scratch.

reply.summary: Miaco is a white-haired mute thug employed as brawn by a gang boss, a revived corpse with a taste for violence. Miaco falls in a scuffle with the heroine and is not mourned.

feats.scene: Miaco hurls a bar stool through a front window in a brawl.
Miaco walks off a fall down a long flight of stairs.

reply.summary: Serninol is a black-haired woman who works for the state, dispatching a stretchy agent to stop absurd criminal organisations. Serninol is nitpicky about her agent, who adores her anyway.

feats.scene: Serninol thumps her desk and demands a field report.
Serninol keeps her composure as a rattled ceiling tile drops on her.
